mapper.select: SELECT r.reservationId, r.reservationDate as date, CONCAT(r.startTime, ' - ', r.endTime) as time, sr.floor, sr.roomName as room, CASE WHEN r.status = 'active' THEN '예약 완료' WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN '예약 완료' WHEN r.status = 'cancelled' THEN '예약 가능' ELSE '예약 불가' END as status FROM reservation r JOIN studyRooms sr ON r.roomId = sr.roomId WHERE r.reservationDate = #{date} AND r.startTime = #{startTime} AND r.roomId = #{roomId} AND r.status != 'cancelled'

SELECT r.reservationId, r.reservationDate as date, CONCAT(r.startTime, ' - ', r.endTime) as time, CONCAT(sr.floor, '층') as floor, sr.roomName as room, CASE WHEN r.status = 'active' THEN '예약 완료' WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN '예약 완료' WHEN r.status = 'cancelled' THEN '예약 가능' ELSE '예약 불가' END as status FROM reservation r JOIN studyRooms sr ON r.roomId = sr.roomId
AND r.status IN ('active', 'completed')
AND r.status = 'cancelled'
AND r.status NOT IN ('active', 'completed', 'cancelled')
ORDER BY r.reservationDate DESC, r.startTime DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN studyRooms sr ON r.roomId = sr.roomId
AND r.status IN ('active', 'completed')
AND r.status = 'cancelled'
AND r.status NOT IN ('active', 'completed', 'cancelled')

SELECT all_combinations.roomId, all_combinations.floor, all_combinations.room, all_combinations.floorDisplay, all_combinations.date, CASE WHEN COALESCE(reserved_counts.reserved_count, 0) >= 13 THEN '예약 불가' ELSE '예약 가능' END as status, CONCAT(COALESCE(reserved_counts.reserved_count, 0), ' / 13') as time_info FROM ( SELECT sr.roomId, sr.floor, sr.roomName as room, CONCAT(sr.floor, '층') as floorDisplay, dates.date_val as date FROM studyRooms sr CROSS JOIN ( SELECT CURDATE() as date_val UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) as date_val ) dates ) all_combinations LEFT JOIN ( SELECT roomId, reservationDate, COUNT(DISTINCT startTime) as reserved_count FROM reservation WHERE status IN ('active', 'completed') AND reservationDate BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY roomId, reservationDate ) reserved_counts ON all_combinations.roomId = reserved_counts.roomId AND all_combinations.date = reserved_counts.reservationDate ORDER BY all_combinations.date, all_combinations.floor, all_combinations.room LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyRooms sr CROSS JOIN ( SELECT CURDATE() as date_val UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) as date_val ) dates
